_comment: sim-place-release-carton-stays-v1. Purpose: coldwin105 -- the FIRST run whose collect pad-down set-down reached the shelf seat (carton centre z 0.6398 -> 0.5307, modelled seat 0.5308, bottom_gap -0.3 mm) -- acknowledged the release end to end (gripper-open, cuMotion detach, 'SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK release', RELEASE_CONFIRMED held=False, RELEASE_FREE_LIFT 'carton at rest, stable 5 ticks') yet the carton stayed physically coupled to the gripper. HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release 'RELEASE_NOT_FREE: carton rose 0.1494 m with the gripper on the 0.060 m clearance lift'. This fragment arms the fix.
_cause: NAMED mechanism (evidence, no model argument): stage.RemovePrim(<gripper>/sim_attach_fallback) removes the FixedJoint USD prim -- so the host read() reports held=False -- but does NOT drop the joint's PhysX CONSTRAINT at runtime (the runtime-USD-does-not-propagate class the PR 384 view-safe note warns about). The carton stayed RIGIDLY WELDED to the gripper: through the whole clearance lift the SEAL_DIAG pad->carton gap held min_gap_mm=0.0 and pad_vs_surface_deg=0.0 (an EXACT rigid relative pose) while the measured carton CENTRE (ground truth) rose 0.1494 m tracking the arm, and the PR 384 contact logger saw ZERO carton-vs-cart contacts for the whole run (the welded carton never touched the shelf). The carton collider WAS re-enabled at release (the seal raycast went from min_gap_mm=None while welded -- collider off, raycast misses it -- to 0.48 mm the tick after release), so the carton is NOT missing a collider; it is still held. RELEASE_FREE's 'at rest, stable 5 ticks' measured the WELD holding the carton at the modelled seat, NOT the shelf supporting it. See data/sim-place-release-carton-stays-v1/report.md for the tick table.
_fix: Two opt-in, coordinated parts (default off => byte-identical). (1) SIM-side robust ORDERED detach (RUNTIME release_detach): _release_fallback re-enables the carton collider, then DISABLES the weld joint EXPLICITLY (clear body0/body1 rels + jointEnabled=False) BEFORE RemovePrim -- so PhysX drops the constraint even when a bare prim removal does not re-sync -- then makes the freed carton a DYNAMIC body (clear any kinematic flag) and ZEROES its residual linear/angular velocity, so it settles onto the shelf under gravity instead of following the gripper. The tool-side colliders stay DEFERRED (restored only on the next grasp close, gripper then clear of the carton => zero-overlap restoration). (2) HOST-side coupled-rise verification (HOST carton_level.release_free_coupled_abort_m): the clearance lift is polled PER TICK and FAILS BY NAME the instant the carton rises past the threshold -- naming a still-coupled carton early and non-destructively, before the lateral retreat, not after the 0.1494 m swing (and the misleading downstream arm-heartbeat loss).

_ON_values_RUNTIME._where: the mission-runtime JSON (external to the repo; a worker PR cannot flip it -- coordinate via the status line). As coldwin105: place_contact_logger (PR 384) stays ON (logger); place_descent_cage_gate.include_support stays OFF (cage-only).

_ON_values_HOST._where: restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json (HOST carton_level block) -- the file the mission manip host reads (host-vs-runtime-config-split). Add release_free_coupled_abort_m to the existing carton_level block; release_free_check was already ON in coldwin105. Everything else (place_release_on_contact + its progress-lag stall arming, place_seat_gate, closed_loop_sensor, place_descent_monotonic_z, place_from_above, ...) stays exactly as coldwin105 ran it.

_expected_console_next_run: At boot: in the Isaac/mission process, 'SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK release-detach ROBUST armed (sim-place-release-carton-stays-v1): the weld joint is disabled ... BEFORE RemovePrim ...' (proves the sim-side arm). At the collect set-down release: 'SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK weld joint DISABLED (body rels cleared + jointEnabled=False) before removal path=...', then 'SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK freed carton velocity zeroed ... (robust detach)', then 'SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK release body=... (robust detach)'. Expected PHYSICS outcome: the freed carton now SETTLES onto the shelf -- a CONTACT_PAIR a=/RestockScenario/HandlingUnit b=/Rollwagen/chassis/shelf ... line appears (the first non-zero carton-vs-cart contact of the run), the RELEASE_FREE settle sees a genuinely resting carton, the clearance lift leaves it (carton rise ~0), and the stage advances to verify. If the detach STILL fails on GPU, the HOST names it EARLY: 'RELEASE_NOT_FREE: carton rose <=0.020 m with the gripper during the clearance lift (>= 0.020 m abort) -- still coupled to the gripper, NOT resting on the support; aborting the lift before the retreat' instead of the 0.1494 m swing + heartbeat loss.
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_release_detach_carton_stays_v1.py (23 tests): the pure ordered-detach planner (robust on/off byte-identical order; disable-before-remove; never kinematic; tool-side deferred => zero-overlap restore); robust_detach_enabled config/env/dict resolution; apply_release_ops reaching a recording physics-layer adapter in order; _release_fallback dispatching the ops to the stage (robust + legacy byte-identical); the real pxr adapter method bodies against a fake pxr (body rels cleared, jointEnabled=False, kinematic=False, velocity zeroed); ReleaseFreeGate.rising_with_gripper + the controller lift-stage early abort; and the config wiring (carton_level parse/validate, ManipConfig.release_detach_robust, config_preflight RUNTIME registration). Write-up: data/sim-place-release-carton-stays-v1/report.md.
_scope: Only the sim-attach-fallback release detach and the post-detach clearance lift. PR 382's seat gate stays the release AUTHORITY (this fix only changes HOW the weld is torn down after the seat gate decides to release) and PR 387/388 (stall arming + monotonic-z descent) are UNCHANGED. Every switch is opt-in and default-off => a run without release_detach and without release_free_coupled_abort_m is byte-identical. Out of scope (unchanged): the descent, the seat-gate decision logic, the re-approach counter, the transfer stage, watchdogs/budgets.
